text_block_list.text: (Rustle, rustle, rustle...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like something's there. A 
boar... or maybe a bear?
choice_data_list: It's dangerous, you should step back...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If I let something like this stop me in my 
tracks, the sun will go down. So—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "W o u l d y o u p l e a s e m o v e ?"
(Rustle!? Patter patter...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us go. In order to "break 
through" this situation—

Aiming for the mountain summit alongside 
Gentildonna. As for how things ended up 
like this—

After our outing, I went hiking in the 
mountains with Gentildonna.

We followed the hiking trail, but it seems 
there was an error on the guide sign...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like we wandered onto an animal 
trail. Into a place where you can't even 
get cell service.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Even so, panicking won't help. Let us aim 
for the summit for now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hiking trails are supposed to lead to the 
summit. If we keep climbing, we should be 
able to rejoin the correct path.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What are you dawdling for? Let's pick up 
the pace a little.

Desperate not to fall behind her, I push 
myself to keep up. At this pace, we should 
reach the summit before it gets dark!
(Drop... Pitter-patter-patter...)
(Shaaaaa...!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Mountain weather changes so 
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. We're quite lucky to find a cave 
in a place like this.

I take shelter from the rain together with 
Gentildonna. However, far from letting up, 
the wind and rain—
(KABLAMMM!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, how pretty. I wonder if another one 
will fall nearby."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of which, you're looking rather 
pale. Why don't you try relaxing a 
little?"

On top of being stranded, the weather is 
awful... Combined with the exhaustion, 
it's hard to stay optimistic.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What a foolish question. It's simply 
because I am "strong."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hence, I have confidence. Confidence that 
whatever calamity may befall me, I can 
brush it aside.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then surely you have 
nothing whatsoever to worry about?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, the sound of the rain has stopped. 
Shall we set off, then?

Pushing hard once more up the muddy 
mountain trail. And, at last—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now we can head back to the academy. I 
want to take a shower as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“Still, thinking back on it now, it was 
quite an entertaining experience, wasn't 
it?”

There was a dazzling aura around 
Gentildonna as she laughed and said that.

"And I realized. In order to stand beside 
her, one needs an unshakeable spirit—"
choice_data_list:
I'll try believing in my own "strength" 
too.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, what an admirable attitude. I shall 
look forward to it, then.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What you will show us, beyond staying true 
to your "strength"—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Hohoho. Those eyes of yours... 
you're looking right ahead, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Then would you show me through your 
results? Actions speak louder than words, 
after all.
